title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.

  • International mindset: International experience is a plus.

  • Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

  • Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience. 
 
At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives. 
 
Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation! 
 
We are currently looking for a Working Student - Community & User Generated Content Operations who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. In this role, your focus will be supporting  the operational management and quality assurance of user-generated content across multiple e-commerce platforms and community channels. The role helps ensure a consistent, trustworthy, and high-quality customer feedback experience by coordinating review processes, monitoring platform performance, and supporting day-to-day content operations.  

What you will do
  • Support moderation and quality control of user-generated content (reviews, Q&A, community interactions).
  • Handle escalated review cases according to moderation guidelines.
  • Monitor review syndication and content quality across brand shops and partner platforms.
  • Ensure new product launches are correctly integrated into review systems. 
  • Identify operational inconsistencies and escalate issues where needed. 
  • Assist with monitoring community/forum activity.
  • Support operational aspects of user research and customer feedback initiatives. 
  • Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency and review quality processes.
  • Help optimize workflows and reporting structures.

    • What you should bring
    • Currently enrolled at a German university in a related discipline with at least 12 months of enrollment remaining.
    • Strong attention to detail and a structured, reliable way of working.
    • Ability to independently manage recurring operational tasks with high accuracy.
    • Analytical and solution-oriented mindset with a hands-on approach.
    • Comfortable working with digital platforms and online tools.
    • Interest in e-commerce, online communities, and customer experience.
    • Confident handling of spreadsheets and data maintenance tasks (e.g. Excel, Google Sheets).
    • Strong written communication skills, with ability to work cross-functionally with different teams and stakeholders.
    • Proactive, collaborative team player with a high level of ownership.

      • Nice to have 

    • Initial experience in moderation, community management, e-commerce, or digital operations.
    • Familiarity with content platforms or review systems.
    • Interest in user research, customer insights, or user-generated content (UGC).

    What we can offer you
    • A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
    • Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
    • Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
    • Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.

description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission


You will be the operational backbone of Alta Ares' field demonstration team — ensuring that every client and partner demonstration runs flawlessly, from equipment preparation through to mission debrief.


On the ground, you are the go-to support for pilots, operators, and engineers: handling logistics, setting up and dismantling demo sites, keeping the equipment fleet in condition, and solving problems on the fly. Your versatility and resourcefulness set you apart — you move seamlessly from a hardware check to a client interaction, from a flight case to a transport declaration, without losing pace or precision.

Key Responsibilities

Demonstration Preparation

  • Prepare and verify all equipment before each mission: drones, ground control stations, batteries, and tooling

  • Pack into flight cases and conduct pre-departure checks

  • Keep inventories accurate and up to date

Checklists & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the operational and equipment checklists — execute them on the day

  • Update checklists after each mission based on field feedback

  • Formalise and improve processes continuously

Logistics & Transport

  • Organise outbound shipments and equipment returns

  • Prepare all transport documentation and coordinate with carriers and the supply chain

  • Ensure material arrives on time and in compliance with applicable regulations, including for sensitive or dual-use equipment

Field Deployment

  • Install and strike the demonstration site

  • Support pilots during flight operations

  • Serve as the on-site point of contact for ground teams, host nation staff, and client representatives

Equipment Maintenance

  • Monitor the condition of the demonstration fleet and report anomalies

  • Carry out first-level maintenance interventions

  • Keep the hardware mission-ready at all times

Administrative Support

  • Prepare authorisation requests and write mission reports

  • Manage expense claims and travel bookings

  • Keep tracking tools up to date: backlog, planning, and mission logs


Candidate Profile

  • Military background or defence sector experience strongly valued: logistics, field support, or operations

  • Understanding of the defence ecosystem required — genuine commitment to national and European sovereignty

  • Versatile and resourceful: you move from a manual handling task to a client conversation without missing a beat

  • Rigorous on equipment and procedures — with the instinct to formalise and improve what can be

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team

  • Available for frequent travel, including internationally and in degraded security environments, sometimes at short notice

  • Professional English — mandatory

  • French driving licence (Permis B) — mandatory; heavy goods licence (Poids Lourd) appreciated

  • Good physical condition — outdoor work and load carrying are part of the role

  • Experience in drone piloting or the UAS/C-UAS ecosystem is a plus

  • Experience shipping sensitive equipment is a plus

title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.
  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by phone +49 89 2441067714.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

 Owkin is looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own first-level support for K-Pro, Owkin's AI research platform for biopharma R&D, used by AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Servier and Boehringer Ingelheim.

Our clients have made major investments to access K-Pro, and their contracts come with strict response and resolution SLAs. You will be their first point of contact during business hours: the person who understands their problem quickly, keeps them informed, and gets the right engineering, product or customer success people moving. You will also help shape how support works at Owkin, including where AI and agentisation make it better.

 

In particular, you will:

Own the support flow

  • Own incoming tickets during business hours as the first line of support for all K-Pro clients

  • Triage every ticket: set priority (P1 to P4) and the impacted service, and route it to the right team

  • Keep SLAs on track: follow up on open tickets, escalate early when a deadline is at risk

  • Communicate clear, timely updates to users and CSMs throughout the ticket lifecycled 

 Go deep on the product

  • Diagnose issues directly with users: reproduce bugs, check data and configurations, and give engineers a clean, actionable report

  • Learn K-Pro in depth (its features, the datasets clients use, how login, API access, exports and permissions work, and the research questions clients bring to it) so you can resolve most issues without escalating

  • Recognise when a result looks scientifically wrong and when it's a usage question

Turn support into insight

  • Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes

  • Track and report on support metrics (response time, SLA compliance, first contact resolution, volume) and give actionable insights to the team.

Own the knowledge base

  • Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

  • Turn one-off fixes into reusable answers for clients and for the support team

Improve support with AI

  • Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality

  • Work with R&Tech Operations to build, test and improve these workflows

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Proven technical support or customer support for B2B software, ideally SaaS, with enterprise clients

  • A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure

  • Strong technical curiosity: comfortable with APIs, logs, data and configurations; basic SQL or scripting is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling and building or improving agentic support workflows (AI-assisted triage, automated routing, LLM-powered drafting), and the judgment to know when automation fits

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain technical issues to scientists and to engineers alike

  • Experience with support tooling such as Zendesk, Linear and PagerDuty, or equivalent

  • Able to follow runbooks and escalation paths, and to know when to deviate from them

  • A habit of turning fixes into documentation and patterns into insights

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience in life sciences, biopharma or another regulated industry is a strong plus

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • You handle the full ticket flow for all K-Pro clients with SLAs met

  • CSMs rely on your signals to anticipate account risks

  • The help center covers the most frequent ticket types

  • You have shipped at least one automation that measurably improves support 

#LI-HB1

 

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: HR & Marketing Coordinator (m/w/d) – Remote CH
description:
What to expect

Are you an organizational talent with initial experience in HR and/or marketing, eager to help shape the intersection of people, marketing, and business development in an HR boutique? Are you tech-savvy, work quickly and precisely, and have a good eye for aesthetics, clear communication, and polished results?

Then you’re a fit for us. We’re not looking for a pure assistant who simply ticks off tasks, but an independent, versatile person who will further develop our external presence, support projects operationally, and relieve the team in day-to-day business—with high velocity, a strong quality mindset, and a genuine drive to contribute.


Your tasks and responsibilities

Marketing & Communication

  • You independently own our marketing channels: LinkedIn, newsletter, website, and online events—from concept and planning through content creation to operational execution
  • You create content for our B2B social media channels—professional, on-brand, and tailored to the target audience
  • You keep our website up to date, maintain content, optimize layout and formatting, and ensure a consistent, aesthetic appearance
  • You plan and organize online events, webinars, and partner events and support their operational delivery
  • You manage communication and coordination with our partners and external service providers

HR & Project Support
  • You support our consulting team on client projects: data analysis, data preparation, research, presentations, and documentation
  • You contribute to HR software implementations—e.g., data migration, test runs, configuration, and quality assurance
  • You support recruiting: candidate sourcing, applicant communication, scheduling, and ATS maintenance
  • You create professional project materials, reports, proposals, and presentations in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and other tools
  • You take on organizational and administrative tasks that relieve the team in day-to-day operations


Your profile


  • 2+ years of professional experience in HR, marketing, project management, or a comparable coordinating role—ideally in a start-up, consulting environment, or agency
  • University degree or completed vocational training in a relevant field
  • Highly tech-savvy: you quickly get up to speed with new tools, platforms, and systems and enjoy optimizing digital processes
  • You work at very high speed, have a quick grasp of new topics, and bring strong organizational talent and project management skills
  • You have a good eye for aesthetics, design, formatting, and spelling—your outputs look professional and are error-free
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; you create visually appealing presentations and documents
  • You understand B2B social media and know how to create professional LinkedIn content that drives reach and relevance
  • Experience with content management systems, newsletter tools (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot), or comparable platforms
  • You work independently, reliably, and in a structured way—even when managing multiple tasks in parallel
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English; additional languages are a plus
  • Based in Switzerland with the appropriate residence and work permits


What we offer


  • Remote only: Work from wherever you’re most productive—on-site at the client only in exceptional cases; team events approx. once per quarter
  • Maximum flexibility: Part-time from 40% (16 hours/week) possible—you set your own working hours
  • Responsibility from day one: You are a core part of our team—no hierarchy, short decision paths
  • Variety: No two days are alike—you work at the intersection of marketing, HR, and project business and get to know the full spectrum of an HR boutique
  • Appreciation: We value you as a team member and as a person—trust, coaching, and honest feedback are part of our culture
